read.thesis: Aptiv's Q3 revenue grew 2% with nonauto up 11-16%, but 2027 is framed as flat ex-recoveries, with a $700M memory-driven recovery that dilutes margin and ~$500M inventory drag on 2026 FCF.

triggers.label: 2027 semiconductor inflation ~$700M
triggers.quote: Currently, we are estimating approximately $700 million in inflation related to semiconductor prices primarily memory

triggers.label: 2026 FCF inventory drag raised to $500M
triggers.quote: The initial $450 million drag on free cash flow associated with spin related costs and supply chain resilience is now $500 million.

triggers.label: 2027 auto growth flat or down, 2 German OEMs
triggers.quote: Third party forecasts as of September are calling for flat vehicle production globally
triggers.highlight: calling for flat vehicle production globally

triggers.label: Portfolio review; update in Q1 27
triggers.quote: we are evaluating the composition of our business and product portfolio, and we will provide an update in the first quarter 27.
triggers.highlight: evaluating the composition of our business and product portfolio

guidance.quote: narrowing the range while maintaining the midpoint of the previous outlook
And for the full year, we are maintaining our income statement guidance from last quarter.
lowering the midpoint by $25 million to $650 million
plan to repurchase at least $650 million by year end
we forecast revenue of $3.2 billion at the midpoint representing adjusted growth of 3%
We expect adjusted EBITDA of $612 million and margin of 19.4% at the midpoint.

guidance.value: flat to slightly positive ex-recoveries; ~$700M semiconductor recovery; intelligent systems headwind $200-300M
guidance.quote: we expect it will be a flat to slightly positive year driven by the combined impact of revenues ex recoveries

red_flags.quote: adjusted EBITDA margin decreased 140 basis points due to product mix, including lower software revenues
